captions.player.nativeLate: Captions are on. This browser plays the stream its own way, so they may appear a moment late.
captions.studio.pageIntro: Open captions for your streams, made on this server. Viewers turn them on with the CC button, and you can correct them on your videos.
captions.studio.settingsIntro: Speech is turned into captions as you stream. Captions appear about 9 seconds behind live for viewers who turn them on.
captions.studio.enabledDefaultOn: You have not chosen, so this follows the instance default, which is on.
captions.studio.enabledDefaultOff: You have not chosen, so this follows the instance default, which is off.
captions.studio.track.queuedHint: This server is captioning as many streams as it can. Your captions start as soon as a slot frees up.
captions.studio.languageHint: The language you speak on stream. It starts as your channel's language.
captions.studio.mask.label: Masked words
captions.studio.mask.hint: One word, phrase or pattern per line. A match shows as [***] in the captions, so viewers know something was said.
captions.studio.mask.errorPattern: Line {line} is not a valid pattern.
captions.studio.mask.errorCount: Line {line} goes past the limit of 100 entries.
captions.studio.mask.errorServer: One of the patterns could be too slow to run. Simplify it and save again.
captions.studio.cost: Captions use this server's processor while you stream. Each server captions a limited number of streams at once.
captions.studio.saveFailed: Your caption settings could not be saved.
captions.studio.privacy: Draft, not yet reviewed: the transcript of a stream is kept with its video and deleted with it. If your channel keeps no videos, the transcript is deleted when the stream ends. Corrections record who made them, by account, not what they changed.
captions.studio.vod.title: Correct captions on videos
captions.studio.vod.intro: Fix the words of any cue. Masked words stay masked.
captions.studio.vod.emptyDescription: Videos of captioned streams appear here once they're ready.
captions.studio.vod.timingFixed: Timing stays as it is; only the text changes.
captions.studio.vod.saveFailed: Your corrections could not be saved.
